stories.title: Cleveland City Council votes to boycott Starbucks in protest of company's labor practices
stories.summary: Cleveland City Council calls for a Starbucks boycott, criticizing its labor practices amid the company's failure to negotiate contracts with its unionized workers.

stories.title: Tensions flare at meeting to discuss new East Side high school in Cleveland, with Collinwood and Glenville residents fighting to preserve their roots
stories.summary: Community tensions rise amid plans for a new $100M high school merging two historic Cleveland rivals, sparking debates over history, facilities, and even the name.

stories.title: Wadsworth police investigate shooting in Walmart parking lot
stories.summary: Police say the suspected shooter, 33-year-old Nicholas Miller, is in custody at the Medina County Jail.

stories.title: Cuyahoga County Public Library says 3rd-party data breach led to cardholders' info being compromised
stories.summary: The Cuyahoga County Public Library has shut down its app after a third-party vendor breach exposed cardholder information, urging users to update security details.

stories.title: 'They're trapped down there': Police bodycam shows response to Broadview Heights house fire that killed North Royalton firefighter
stories.summary: Police body camera footage captures the response to the Nov. 2 house fire that killed North Royalton firefighter Ryan Milligan and left another seriously injured.

stories.title: D'Shawntae Jones' 2TDs help lead Miami (Ohio) to dominant 20-3 win over Kent State
stories.summary: D'Shawntae Jones ran for 121 yards and two touchdowns and Miami (Ohio) beat Kent State 20-3. The Golden Flashes are now 3-8 on the season, with one game left.

stories.title: Xavier hangs on for 75-67 victory against Cleveland State men's basketball
stories.summary: Led by Michael Nwoko's 19 points, the Xavier Musketeers defeated the Cleveland State Vikings 75-67 on Tuesday, despite a valiant second-half effort by the Vikings.

stories.title: Cleveland Browns legend Bernie Kosar to discuss recovery 1 year after liver transplant surgery: Watch Wednesday at 11 a.m.
stories.summary: Kosar will return to University Hospitals one year after a lifesaving liver transplant, sharing his remarkable recovery amid health challenges.

stories.title: Ohio Gov.-elect Amy Acton says more than 5,000 people have applied to work for her
stories.summary: Acton has 55 days until inauguration to build her administration

stories.title: Former Morton Salt workers sue over alleged labor law violations after Lake County mine flood
stories.summary: Three former Morton Salt mine workers are suing the company, claiming it ignored warnings about flood risks and failed to provide required notice before layoffs.

stories.title: US Marshals arrest 3rd suspect accused of killing 10-year-old Cleveland boy Kaden Coleman
stories.summary: Khalif Muhammed, 34, was arrested early Tuesday morning in McMechen, West Virginia, by members of the U.S. Marshals Northern Ohio Violent Fugitive Task Force.

stories.title: Breaking the cycle: Northeast Ohio father confronts childhood trauma to build a better future for his children
stories.summary: After battling addiction and spending time in prison, Patrick Vorreiter found hope through The City Mission's Crossroads program.
